missions.comment: Form a band, release a record and get on the Top 10
missions.name: First Steps
missions.IntroText: You are in the lower reaches of the music industry, and there are few who believe you can manage a Top 10 hit, stacking the odds up against you completing the Rock Manager journey to fame and fortune found in the upper echelons of the music industry.\n   Prove them wrong, get a Top 10 hit!
missions.SucceedText: Well done! <¤Calbum.name> entered the Top 10 showing the biz your promise but the critics slate the band as a 'One hit wonder'.\n   <¤CBand.name> are destined to be a flash-in-the-pan so drop them and move on to the next mission.\n   In the right column you can see a summary of how much points you got in this mission.
missions.FailText: That didn't go too well. Perform and try to build up a following making your musicians more interesting to the labels and generating revenues for the band.\n   Take recording seriously and use session musicians if your own artists fail you. Record a new song if the first one is a flop with the labels.
missions.CriteriaText:
 Put a Band Together 
 Get a Song License 
 Record a Demo 
 Sign a Record Contract 
 Make the Top 10

missions.comment: An offer from Global Records might spell success.
missions.name: A Family Affair
missions.IntroText: Global Records entrust you to manage the Golander brothers, a talented duo destined for great heights. Your task is to make sure they don't break up.\n   No easy task as they bicker to the point of fisty-cuffs and you have only ten weeks to appease the brothers and get them on stage to play the Global Aid Gala at the Colosseum and make as much money from them in the process.\n   If you succeed expect more offers from Global. Failure is not an option.
missions.SucceedText: You made it! Global Aid was a resounding success. The Colosseum was sold out and the TV-viewers donated millions to Global.\n   <¤CSong.name> was one of the best performances of the show, despite the Golander brothers are relatively unknown. Global now know who to count on.
missions.FailText: How hard could it be? You were supposed to keep two brothers from fighting for a few months and you fail! Small wonder nobody believes in you as a manager. You can forget about the offer from Global, too.\n   Try again and make sure the duo get on this time.
missions.CriteriaText:
 Record Supermarket Love 
 Get Label Approval 
 Release Album 
 Make Cash 
 Keep Band from Breaking Up

missions.comment: Sergey's daughter wants to be a star. Are you the right person for the job?
missions.name: Hey Princess
missions.IntroText: A "business man and entrepreneur" called Sergey Spektor contacts you to manage his daughter Nadia. She has wanted to be a singer all her life and Sergey is offering $120.000 to make her a star.\n   Nadia is uglier than sin and rumour has it that she has a voice to match.\n   All Nadia asks for in life is to appear on TV, and your job is to make it happen.
missions.SucceedText: At last Nadia appeared on TV and Sergey is proud enough to offer you his "services" should you need "help" with anything  anything at all.
missions.FailText: Sergey's patience is through. You were given plenty of chances and still failed. Sergey does not accept failure.\n   You have let him down and, worse, you have let his beloved daughter down. Sergey suggests you keep your head down.\n   Try again, and give Nadia singing lessons next time.
missions.CriteriaText:
 Hire Musicians for Nadia's Band 
 Get a Song License
 Release Record 
 Get 45% Hype 
 Get Nadia on TV

missions.comment: Firewolf are raring for a comeback tour before retiring to live off of the proceeds.
missions.name: Metal to the Masses
missions.IntroText: Fifteen years ago Firewolf were at the zenith of their career. They packed arenas and ruled the sales charts.\n   Of late the band enjoys only very modest success but Firewolf are on the comeback trail and hire you to manage their final recording and farewell.
missions.SucceedText: Well done! Firewolf's farewell tour was what dreams are made of and you took a band from yester-year to the youth of today.\n   You are name dropped in awe throughout backstage areas the world over.
missions.FailText: Bitter and disappointed Firewolf sack you as manager.\n   They invested savings on a grand sortie into the Rock 'n' Roll circus, but your incompetence means Firewolf will spend the rest of their lives as entertainers in third class strip joints.\n   Try again making sure you have a successful album out before attempting a world tour.
missions.CriteriaText:
 Get a Record Deal 
 Release an Album 
 Sell 25 000 Copies 
 Go on a World Tour (minimum three stops)

missions.comment: Poor Nick Chesterton can't stand the pressure but returns to the fray like a duck to water.
missions.name: Kind of Blue
missions.IntroText: Your mission is to make as much money as possible out of the talents of Nick Chesterton whose debut album "So Much Pain, So Little Hope" was a unanimous favourite with the critics.\n   The attention was too much for Nick, who fled the limelight. Now a few years have passed and Nick is ready for a comeback.\n   With expectations high Nick may not make it so fleece him before he shuns the limelight and flees the biz.
missions.SucceedText: So he gave up at last? Well, it was only a question of time before that would happen.\n   Nick Chesterton is a double nature, as much as he hates attention he can't live without music.\n   He'll be back again surely, but by then you'll be busy with bigger things. Anyway, you made some dough from this little adventure.
missions.FailText: Yeah? The set up was perfect. You had the press AND the public on your side. Everybody wanted a piece of Nick Chesterton.\n   It should have been an easy stroll to the Rock 'n' Roll Hall of Fame, but you couldn't even handle that.\n   Try again, and don't spend your money so quickly this time around.
missions.CriteriaText:
 Hire Musicians for Nick's Band 
 Record a Demo 
 Release Record 
 Sell 30,000 Copies Before Nick Quits Pop

missions.comment: Concept band or proper artists  can The Space Cadets make the leap?
missions.name: The Space Cadets
missions.IntroText: Take a band dressed up as astronauts receiving media attention for their gimmicky look with a chart hit with an over-produced song and turn them into a serious act.\n   The Space Cadets actually count themselves as serious artists. All you need do now is convince the press the same.
missions.SucceedText: A happy end for the Space Cadets who win the support of critics and the record buyers alike. Now they can forever release live albums and greatest hits compilations.\n   Thanks to your efforts, they won't be needing you anymore.
missions.FailText: Having had no success trying to become respected artists, The Space Cadets have decided to give up. Now they'll return to their day jobs in various record shops.\n   You may try again and make sure to do better this time. Remember the critics are more interested in musical progression then commercial success, so throw in lots of gizmo sound effects when recording.
missions.CriteriaText:
 Buy a Song License
 Record a Demo
 Release an Album
 Sell 100,000 Copies
 Get Good Reviews

missions.comment: Drive the naïve music lovers out of business!
missions.name: War on Rainbow
missions.IntroText:
The naïve music lovers of Rainbow Records have eluded Global for several years.
   So far Rainbow have refused to be purchased by Global (who already own the other labels in Rock City), but now Global see their chance.
   Rainbow have economic problems and must take their chances with an unproven artist to stay in business.
   Your mission is to sell an artist to Rainbow, record a disastrous song and bankrupt Rainbow's coffers so Global can take over the company.
missions.SucceedText: Splendid! The last threat to Global's control of music distribution is bankrupt.
missions.FailText: <¤Cband.name> sold thousands and G. Jerome Vonderbaldt is furious. You have given the naïve music lovers of Rainbow a lifeline.\n   Global's cunning plan amounted to nothing and your career is in tatters. Try again making sure Rainbow are liquidated.
missions.CriteriaText:
 Put a Crap Band Together 
 Record a Demo 
 Sign with Rainbow 
 Don't Make Them any Money 
 Make Rainbow Go Bankrupt

missions.name: The Perfect Song
missions.IntroText:
The Global president G. Jerome Vonderbaldt has a new task for you.
   Frustrated by not being able to control the whole music production process, Global have spent millions on research into consumer behaviour.
   The research has paid off as what Global call "The Perfect Song"  the song to end all songs.
   Global have put together a band and want you to manage "The Perfect Band." Conquer the world!
missions.SucceedText:
Perfect! Total Global Domination.
   The Perfect Song can be recorded and marketed over and over again endlessly. It's perfect and the audience will never grow tired of it.
   Thanks to your efforts, Global's music will be the only music. You are of course richly compensated and will never have to work again.
   You have earned a total of <formatInteger(¤CPlayer.getTotalPoints(#Mission09))> points.
   The game is over and Global thank you for your interest. The points in this last mission will not be counted towards your total score. Don't ask.
missions.FailText: Despite The Perfect Set Up and Global's research investments, you failed to turn The Perfect Song into a global hit.\n   Due to your failure Global has ruined years of research and your career is in the balance.\n   Restart and complete the mission successfully
missions.CriteriaText:  Record and Promote the Perfect Song

missions.comment: No orders, no objectives - just 100% ROCK!
missions.name: The Sky is the Limit
missions.IntroText: Yeah yeah, you made it. You have had your fifteen minutes of fame. What? Want more? Just can't get enough of that rock'n'roll lifestyle huh?!\n\nAllright, here you go: a whole year of rock'n'roll! Go out there, get dirty and do whatever you feel like. Kick out the jam!
missions.SucceedText: Allright people, move on! There is nothing to see here. This party is over!
missions.FailText: Ooops! Maybe you weren't made to live a life of rock'n'roll after all? You better go home to mummy now! Or do you want to give it another try?
